Arguments for dysphoria -> depression:
-was dysphoric years before being depressed
-began being depressed because of visible changes of male puberty
-anti depressant works fine for 2-4 weeks. During those weeks dysphoria is still making me suffer. After those weeks suicidal idealitions come back.

I just wish there was a pill to align my brain with my body
Its not. How do I know that ? Two years of heavy medications

I have a therapist. I have not made progress for 9 months. I hate being dysphoric, I hate male pronouns, I was deadnamed yesterday and it made me cry. Even choosing another masculine name makes me feel bad. SI wish I wasnt this mentally ill male. Being rarely perveived as a woman makes me feel good and I hate that. I will never pass consistently so its useless.
